subject: RE: OrbitLine renewal — capacity uplift / competitor bake-off concerns
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@orbitline.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orbitline.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal coming up — discussing expansion and a bake-off

Hi Sofia,

OrbitLine's renewal for our Enterprise plan is coming up in October and we expect a 2-3x usage growth next year as we roll ML features into checkout and fraud workflows. We're also running a short bake-off with ScaleCloud for a couple of high-throughput routes. Procurement asked me to reach out before we get too far down that path — we'd prefer to keep the relationship with Redwood if we can get predictable capacity and some help on unit economics.

Specific asks:
- Quick latency/throughput benchmark for our current workload (see attached usage snapshot).
- Options for a dedicated capacity uplift (GPU pool + burst) and pricing for 12/24 month terms.
- Any short-term credits or migration support you can offer to make the transition easier.

Can we schedule a 30-min call this week? I can share the bake-off timeline — they want results in two weeks.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Wu
Head of ML Ops, OrbitLine

Attachments: orbitline_current_usage_snapshot.csv, orbitline_benchmark_request.pdf

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@orbitline.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal coming up — discussing expansion and a bake-off

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the snapshot. We absolutely want to keep OrbitLine on Redwood and have a playbook for short timelines like this.

I'll put together an initial benchmark pass focused on your 95th-percentile latency and steady-state throughput, plus a draft dedicated uplift configuration. Quick notes for the call:
- Can you confirm peak concurrent token rates for the checkout routes and expected QPS for fraud scoring?
- Do you require KV cache locality (single-region) or can you accept cross-region routing for cost optimization?

I'm free Tue/Wed afternoon — happy to do 30m. I'll loop in our renewal lead and performance SME.

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

P.S. We can share a lightweight comparison matrix against the typical rivals; would you like that in the call or as a follow-up?

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: OrbitLine renewal — urgent bake-off (info + ask)

Team — forwarding OrbitLine's request (attached). They go to market with ScaleCloud in ~2 weeks. They want: a fast benchmark, a dedicated uplift config, and a short-term commercial incentive.

Quick asks:
- Marissa: can you run the benchmark templates against the usage snapshot and produce a 1-page summary (latency P95, cost/token, recommended quantization)? Attach to the external response.
- Karthik: need options for uplift SKUs (dedicated pool sizes, burst policy) and proposed term pricing for 12/24 months; also potential credit structure (one-off migration credit vs. monthly discount).
- Marcus: ops commitments we can reasonably promise for an uplift within 30 days (SLOs, migration support hours, dedicated on-call during cutover).

Goal: have a single external reply that feels consultative, includes benchmark PDF, and a concrete uplift term sheet. Internal deadline EOD today so we can get on a call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Sofia

Attachments: orbitline_benchmark_request.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: OrbitLine renewal — urgent bake-off (info + ask)

Sofia / team — ran the workload snapshot through our benchmark harness. Key takeaways (summary attached):
- P95 latency (current model family) at reported peak QPS: 220ms (single-region, KV-local). With optimized batching and 8-bit quantization we can get to ~270ms at 2.5x throughput and 35% lower cost/token.
- Cost model: estimated annual unit cost increases by 1.8x if they stay on multi-tenant hosted without uplift; dedicated pool reduces per-token cost by ~28% at their projected volumes.
- Risks: their top checkout route has tight tail latency needs during flash promotions; recommend reserving a small burst buffer (20% headroom) and an explicit fallback to a lower-cost variant for non-critical traffic.

Attached: redwood_benchmark_summary_v1.pdf (incl. graphs), short-run cmd outputs. I also sketched a term-sheet: 12-mo uplift (3x GPU pool) + 60k one-off migration credit or 10% annual discount spread over 12 months.

If everyone agrees, I'll incorporate the term-sheet into the external reply.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_benchmark_summary_v1.pdf

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@scalecloud.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@orbitline.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: OrbitLine renewal — quick note on the bake-off

Alex — looping you in on our preliminary numbers (no attachments here — will send full report on the call). TL;DR: we can match your P95 at slightly lower cost on our A100 pools for the first month; however, we require a 60-day lead to guarantee sustained throughput at scale.

If OrbitLine is open, we can do a staged pilot and show runbooks for cache locality and burst. Happy to present to your SREs.

Cheers,
Daniel Park
Director, Solutions Engineering, ScaleCloud

--Forwarded to Sofia by Alex for visibility--

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@orbitline.com>, Procurement <procurement@orbitline.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: OrbitLine renewal — proposed retain & scale offer

Alex / Procurement team — thanks for the context and for sharing the bake-off timeline. Attached is a concise proposal that balances your scale needs and the short vendor timeline. Highlights below: 

Offer summary
- Dedicated uplift: 3x GPU pool (single-region), automated burst policy up to +30% for 90 days during peak campaigns.
- Pricing: 12-month committed term with 10% effective discount on per-token pricing (spread as monthly credits) OR a 24-month term with a 15% discount.
- Migration support: 40 hours of dedicated onboarding + 2 weeks of prioritized on-call during cutover.
- One-off retention credit: $60k available if OrbitLine signs a 12-month uplift within 10 business days (we can convert to monthly credits if preferred).
- Ops SLOs: P95 latency target commitments for critical routes with a documented rollback plan and a fall-through lower-cost variant.

Next steps
1) If this is appealing, let's lock a 30-min technical alignment call this week (Sofia + Marissa + Marcus).
2) Procurement: if you want legal terms, we'll prepare a short addendum to the current agreement; I can draft and share a DocuSign link.
3) If you want Redwood to run the official bake-off, we will run a controlled pass with your data in our staging region and share detailed reports within 72 hours.

We're committed to making the migration low risk and to protecting your unit economics as you scale. If you want us to match any specific items from ScaleCloud's written proposal, point to them and we'll evaluate.

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-uplift-term-sheet.pdf
